plan.archetype: Efficient early attacks into poison and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Enter healthy with reliable damage, upgraded weakness and defensive scaling. Discard or play Beckon; defend during intangible turns. Add Accelerant after establishing reliable poison.
plan.summary: Acquire immediate damage and AoE before selective elites. Use Conch to earn relics, then develop poison and dexterity. Remove Strikes after replacing their damage; balance upgrades against necessary healing.

plan.archetype: Poison damage with efficient attacks and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Upgrade Footwork and key poison or weakness cards. Enter healthy, handle Beckon promptly, and defend during intangible turns. Add Accelerant after reliable poison.
plan.summary: Establish reliable poison while preserving efficient attacks. Upgrade defensive scaling, remove Injury then Strikes, and use the two remaining fires to balance upgrades with boss-entry health.
